rules: All orders, balances, dates and results are fictional. No payment or external service is contacted.
The fixed as_of date makes this demonstration repeatable; it does not use today's clock.
damaged_item, wrong_item and changed_mind are eligible only after delivery and within 30 calendar days of delivery, inclusive.

not_received is eligible only while an order is shipped and the fixed as_of date is strictly later than expected_delivery_date. A delivered order requires a separate dispute workflow that this demo does not implement.
Any reason is ineligible when remaining_refundable is zero.
Refund proposals require a positive INR amount with at most two decimal places, no greater than remaining_refundable.
A proposal is an immutable simulation: it does not reserve money, change balances, or execute a refund. Repeating a proposal produces the same proposal ID.
